# sca completion

[← Command reference](../commands.md)

`<sca_options>` are the [global options](../commands.md#global-options).

```text
The completion command help

The completion command is used for retrieving the (auto)completion script.

The completion scripts are used by shell to interactively complete commands.
To use the completion script, save the output of this command to
/etc/bash_completion.d/sca file.
```

**Syntax**

```text
sca [<sca_options>] completion [<completion_options>] [<shell>]

completion_options:

  -h, --help      - print this help

The shell parameter is optional and is intended for future use. Currently,
the only supported value is 'bash'.
```

**Example:**

```bash
# Load completion in the current shell, e.g. from ~/.bashrc
source <(sca completion bash)
```
